quote: tending to injured soldiers at her father's home and in the Catholic church where hundreds of wounded US and Confederate soldiers were hospitalized

claim: The Patriot Daughters of Lancaster write of Gettysburg on their arrival that every house was a hospital and that wounded men in every attitude were seen through the open doors and windows.

source.edition: Hospital scenes after the battle of Gettysburg, July 1863, by the Patriot Daughters of Lancaster (Lancaster: Daily Inquirer Steam Job Print, 1864; title page read)

quote: Every house was a hospital, and through the open doors and windows were seen wounded men in every attitude.

scene.may_show: Town houses with open doors and windows and wounded men lying and sitting in every attitude inside, on the day the ladies arrive.
scene.reduced_form: doors and windows of houses with covered shapes inside

notes: their arrival day is not printed in this sentence (about ten in the morning, some days after the battle)
